results.title: The Divine Feminine Live
results.overview: A re-release of the live performance of The Divine Feminine by Mac Miller from 2016, as re-imagined by Sam Balaban in honor of its 10th anniversary.

results.title: Uncovering Duke Gawthorpe
results.overview: After being contacted by documentarians, aristocrat Duke Gawthorpe loses his lucky antique Kazoo. He must go on a mission to try and find it before all hope is lost.

results.title: Check
results.overview: On the eve of a military deployment, two old friends meet for dinner.

results.title: The Automotive Dead
results.overview: Three guys are working away in the autoshop on a classic car when things take a turn... The car becomes possessed and will devour anyone in sight. Will Paul and George survive, or will they be run down by THE AUTOMOTIVE DEAD!!!

results.title: Stone Glass Metal
results.overview: Capturing the modern and ancient architecture of Spain with a 2001 camcorder.

results.title: To Catch a Stepfather
results.overview: After the death of her husband, Allison Simon finds love again with charming businessman Roger, but her son Eric quickly senses something sinister beneath his new stepfather's perfect facade.

results.title: Four Days In June
results.overview: A Midwest arts festival brings 60,000 people together for four days of music, food, and creativity, revealing how shared experiences can create rare common ground in a divided world.

results.title: Expectation
results.overview: In a remote village of Anatolia, the dead body of a female doctor creates a deep curiosity among the villagers. The shepherd who didn’t confess his treatment because of his social fear, becomes the main suspect of the incident. Meanwhile for the lawyer the village he visited coincidentally to find peace gradually turns into darkness of expectations which are manipulating the truth or maybe it’s the truth hiding somewhere closer no one dares to look.

results.title: John of Town
results.overview: A fantastic short film that psychologically explores celebrity hypocrisy, depicts a society consumed by conformity, and satirizes the ridicule of philosophy. Pedro, excited to attend a speech by the famous philosopher "Joan de Vila," goes to see one, but it turns out not to be what he had imagined.

results.title: HERRATA
results.overview: After being abducted by a deranged family living deep in the countryside, a young man awakens to a nightmarish dinner where nothing is quite what it seems. As the family’s disturbing rituals unfold, he must find a way to survive the night.

results.title: Darwin's Amazing Animals: Cats Around the World
results.original_title: 劇場版ダーウィンが来た！世界のネコのなかまたち
results.overview: From the deserts of Africa to the forests and islands of Japan, explore the remarkable lives of the world's wild cats. Lions, cheetahs, jaguars, caracals, servals, fishing cats, leopards, Tsushima leopard cats, Pallas's cats and other feline predators reveal their surprising hunting skills, family bonds and struggles for survival. Guided by the animated Pallas's cats Manu and Tsunomin, this nature documentary journeys around the world to discover the extraordinary diversity and shared instincts of the cat family.

results.title: Swans: Newly Sentient Being
results.overview: Goodbye to this stellar version of Swans. Newly Sentient Being features superb recordings of Swans’ final concert of the “Big Sound” era, the apotheosis of 15 years of cosmic sonic expressionism, alternately heavenly and debased, visceral and transcendent.

results.title: Woven Ground
results.overview: Composer Blair Coron takes his musical instruments, recording equipment and friends to the islands, glens and forests of Scotland to record directly in the landscapes that inspired the music.

results.title: Dreary Midwest Cowboy
results.overview: A childhood cowboy rivalry turns deadly as two brothers mirror the games they used to play.

results.title: Sucker
results.overview: After a bat bite, a seedy motel clerk develops an insatiable craving for blood, starting with her own.

results.title: Please + Thank You
results.overview: A anxious klutz hopes to earn his food delivery driver’s forgiveness.

results.title: French Fries
results.overview: Years after abandoning the film they once dreamed of making together, two old friends reunite on the set of a television series. As they prepare french fries in a trailer, memories, old ambitions and long-buried disappointments resurface. Their conversation gradually becomes a confrontation with the choices, compromises and excuses that have shaped their lives, raising a simple question: Do we give up on our dreams because we change, or do we change because we give up on our dreams?

results.title: Gran Blanco
results.overview: A portrait of an American tourist in Mexico.
